{What thematic move should Black play to start counterattacking the white
center?} 5... c5 {[%wrong There's a better way to attack the white center. Try
again.] [%hint Use a pawn to undermine White's central pawn chain.]} (5... f6
$2 6. Bd3 {This is sometimes a good idea, but here it's premature and White
has a good position thanks to the exposed black king. Try again and look for a
better pawn break.}) (5... b6 $5 {This is playable, but there's a more popular
and stronger option. Try to find a powerful pawn break.}) 6. Bd3 {Good start!
How should you develop another piece to keep attacking d4?} Nc6 {[%wrong That
doesn't develop a piece to attack d4. Try again.] [%hint What's the best
square for your b8 knight?] Well played! Black is preparing counterplay
against the white center.} (6... Qb6 $2 {It's more flexible to develop another
piece before the queen. Which other black piece can attack d4?}) (6... cxd4 $5
{This is playable, but there's a better move. Try to find a way to develop and
target d4.}) (6... a5 $5 {This is playable, but there's a better move. Try to
find a way to develop and target d4.}) 0-1

promising pawn sacrifice. What should White play?} 8. O-O {[%wrong There's a
better option. Try to find it and check the hint if you're stuck.] [%hint
Secure your king instead of defending d4.]} (8. a3 $5 {This is playable, but
it's better to continue development. What should you play?}) (8. dxc5 $2 Nxc5 {
Black is slightly better. Try to find a strong developing move.}) 8... cxd4 {
Nice move! How should you recapture?} 9. cxd4 {[%wrong There's a better option.
Try to find a good capture.] [%hint Recapture and defend e5.]} (9. Nxd4 $2
Ncxe5 {Black is better. Try to find a stronger capture.}) 9... Nxd4 {Nice
work! What should you play next?} 10. Nxd4 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try
to find a precise capture.] [%hint Lure the black queen into an exposed
position.]} Qxd4 {Good move! How should you make a threat and defend e5?} 11.
Nf3 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find a strong threat.] [%hint
Defend e5 and attack the black queen.] Good choice! White has a lead in
development and good compensation for the sacrificed pawn.} *

{What move should Black play to attack the white center?} 8... f6 {[%wrong
There's a better move to attack the white center. Try to find it.] [%hint
Attack the head of White's pawn chain.]} (8... Qb6 $2 9. Nf3 {White has d4
well defended. Try again.}) 9. exf6 {Good start! How should you recapture?}
Nxf6 {[%wrong White just won a pawn, so Black should recapture. Try again.] 
[%hint What piece typically belongs on f6 in the opening?]} (9... Qxf6 $5 10.
O-O {The queen may be exposed on f6, making this a risky option, but it is
playable. Try again to see if you can find a safer choice.}) (9... gxf6 $2 10.
O-O {Black's king will be vulnerable on the h5-e8 diagonal. Try again.}) 10.
Nf3 {Good move! What's the most active square for your f8-bishop to head to so
you can castle?} Bd6 {[%wrong That move doesn't prepare to castle. Try to find
a move so you can castle on the next turn.] [%hint Control the center with
your f8 bishop.] Well played! Black has active pieces and is ready to castle.}
(10... Be7 $2 {There's a more active square for that bishop. Try again.}) (
10... Bc5 $2 11. dxc5 {That's not safe. Try again.}) (10... Ba3 $2 11. bxa3 {
That's not safe. Try again.}) (10... Bb4+ $2 {The bishop is misplaced on b4.
Try to find a more active option.}) (10... g6 $5 {This is playable, but
there's a better move. Try to find it.}) 0-1

{The knight is in danger on h5, but Black has a strong, thematic sacrifice to
build up an attack. What should you play?} 16... Rxf3 {[%wrong White wins
material for not much compensation. Try to find a better move.] [%hint Force
open White's kingside.]} (16... Nf4 $5 17. Nxf4 {This is playable, but White
is slightly better. Try to find a more aggressive option.}) (16... Nf6 $5 {
This is playable, but White is slightly better. Try to find a more aggressive
option.}) (16... Bxh2+ $2 17. Nxh2 {White is winning. Try to find a stronger
capture.}) 17. gxf3 {Good start! How can you win back some material?} Bxh2+ {
[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find a good capture.] [%hint What can
you capture with check?]} 18. Kh1 {Well played! Now, what's the most active
square for your h5 knight?} Nf4 {[%wrong There's a better way to save your
knight. Try to find it.] [%hint It's OK to block your queen-bishop battery as
long as your knight can create threats.] Well played! Kxh2 isn't a threat
because of Nxg6+. Black has a strong attack and went on to win.} (18... Nf6 $2
19. Bxf6 {White is winning. Try again and look for a powerful knight move.})
0-1

{When White plays Nd2 or Na3 it allows Black a timely capture. What should
you play?} 7... cxd4 {[%wrong There's a better move for Black. Try to find a
good capture.] [%hint Once White's knight can no longer reach the c3-square,
it's a good time to capture on d4.]} (7... Nf5 $5 8. Nc2 {This is playable
but gives White an extra option of capturing on d4 later with the c2-knight.
Try to find a more forcing move.}) (7... Qb6 $2 8. dxc5 {There's a better move
to prevent White from capturing on c5. Try again.}) (7... c4 $2 8. b3 {White
has a good position. Try again and look for a strong capture.}) (7... a6 $5 {
This is playable, but there's another strong and more forcing option. What is
it?}) (7... Ng6 $5 {This is playable, but there's another strong and more
forcing option. What is it?}) 8. cxd4 {Good start! How can you keep developing
and pressure d4?} Nf5 {[%wrong There's a better move to keep developing and
pressure d4. Try to find it.] [%hint Find the best square for your e7-knight
to pressure the center.]} (8... Qb6 $5 {This is a good option, but lets
developed another piece to attack d4. How can you do it with a knight?}) (8...
Rc8 $5 {This is a good option, but let's developed another piece and target d4.
How can you do it with a knight?}) 9. Nc2 {Good move! How can you continue to
develop and pressure d4?} Qb6 {[%wrong That doesn't develop a new piece to
attack d4. Try again.] [%hint What piece can you move from the back rank to
increase pressure on the d4 pawn?] Great job! Black has a good position. White
is tied down defending the d4 weakness.} 0-1

{What thematic move did GM Shirov play to trade off the bad French bishop?} 
12... Bb5 {[%wrong That doesn't trade off the bad bishop. Try again.] [%hint
The bad bishop in the French is your light square bishop, which is blocked by
the d5-and e6-pawns. It's a good idea to try to trade it.]} (12... h5 $5 {
This is OK, but it doesn't trade the d7-bishop. How can you do that?}) 13. Nd3
{Good start. Now there's another important idea to open the kingside where
White has castled. What should Black play?} h5 {[%wrong There's a better move
to open the kingside. Try again.] [%hint Attack the g4-pawn and develop your
h8-rook.]} (13... f6 $2 14. exf6 {This exposes White's king more than Black's
king. Try again.}) 14. gxh5 {Good move! Now you can take advantage of White's
missing h-pawn to secure a great square for your e7-knight. Where does that
piece belong?} Nf5 {[%wrong There's a better way to improve your e7 knight.
Try to find it.] [%hint Use your e7 knight to pressure the d4 pawn.] Great
job! Black's pieces come to life and White's king will miss having a g-pawn in
front of it.} (14... Nec6 $2 15. b4 {Black's knights get in the way of each
other. Try to find a better move.}) 0-1

{How should White sacrifice to take advantage of the lead in development?} 12.
Nxe6 {[%wrong There's a stronger option. Try to find a powerful sacrifice.] 
[%hint Sacrifice a piece to open the e-file towards Black's king.]} (12. Bxe6
$2 O-O {Black is OK. Try to find a stronger attacking move.}) 12... fxe6 {
Good start! What should you capture next?} 13. Qxe6+ {[%wrong There's a
stronger move. Try to find a good capture.] [%hint Capture a pawn with check.]}
(13. Bxe6 $2 Ne5 {Black is better. Try to find a more effective capture.}) (13.
Bxf6 $2 Nxf6 {Black is better. Try to find a more effective capture.}) 13...
Be7 {Well played! How should you keep chasing the black king?} 14. Qf7+ {
[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find a precise check.] [%hint Check to
force Black to move the king.]} (14. O-O-O $5 {White is doing well, but
there's a better move. Try to find a good check.}) 14... Kd8 {Nice job! Which
way should White castle?} 15. O-O-O {[%wrong There's a stronger move. Try to
find the right way to castle.] [%hint Castle and pin the d7-knight.] Great
work! We'll continue the game Adams - Wan in the next challenge.} (15. O-O $5 {
This is a good move, but there's an even better way to secure your king. Try
to find it.}) (15. Nd4 $2 Qe5+ {White is only slightly better. Try to find a
stronger move.}) 1-0
